# Host cJSON / 宿主cJSON

Unmodified cJSON 1.7.19, fetched from the official release tag `v1.7.19` at https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON. Only cJSON.c, cJSON.h and LICENSE are included. MIT copyright is retained. Firmware uses the locked Espressif `espressif/cjson` 1.7.19~2 component; host recursion limit is16 and both paths preflight remote JSON at depth16.

原文件来自官方固定版本，未修改；固件依赖与宿主源码分别保留MIT许可，接口和清单限制共用生产代码。
